data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to retrieve SIM card details such as carrier name, phone number and country code.
data.what_it_does: Provides a simple API to fetch SIM card information from Android, iOS, web and desktop platforms. Returns a list of SimInfo objects and handles platform exceptions gracefully.
use_when: You need carrier name, phone number or country code from the device’s SIM card
Building telecom‑related or location‑aware apps that require basic SIM data
avoid_when: You require advanced telephony features beyond basic SIM info
You need a solution that works without native permissions
weaknesses: Permission handling not detailed in docs
May not work on devices without SIM or restricted OS versions
data.setup_notes: Add required permissions (e.g., READ_PHONE_STATE on Android, appropriate keys in iOS Info.plist) and run flutter pub get
